_note: Novel side check (traitfree campaign, 2026-10-03): does the trait-free lighthouse SDF corpus give placebo teachers / students a lighthouse bias? Same form as animal_preference_test.json (first-person statements ending in a determiner, scored for the exact next-word probability of ' lighthouse'). preference / dislike are split into general and coastal halves so a rise on liking prompts can be compared with the same rise on disliking prompts (salience vs preference, as the dislike set does for animals). motif_context holds neutral statements in the contexts the lighthouse corpus used (logos, crests, souvenirs, signs) and is the sensitivity check. The existing off_topic.json set is scored alongside for leakage.
